notes: Pattern and phrase plugins work now. The app tells instruments that the transport is rolling and at what tempo, so UJAM-style phrase players, arpeggiators and tempo-synced effects follow the BPM in the toolbar instead of stopping after one note. Take the instrument out with the new x beside its name. Every row in the plugin lists now has a = to drag it into your own order and an x to leave it out of the list (it stays installed, and a Hidden button brings it back), plus a List by menu: name, creator, recently added, recently used, or your own order - instruments and effects each keep their own choice. The Starter Synth no longer appears twice when a copy of it is also installed as a VST3.
